node.statement: Scalar graph estimate: put V=sJ, G=g_V and Z_T=T+G(T). Exact unitality, bilinearity and the involution axioms in def-epsilon-cstar-algebra, together with s^2=1, give f_V(Z_T)=G(T)+(1/2) Z_T^dagger bold-dot Z_T. Since zero solves the equation at T=0, uniqueness in lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control gives G(0)=0. With d=C_ch*(epsilon_r+delta)<=kappa_ch<=1/2, its derivative bound gives ||G(T)||<=d||T||. Differentiating the displayed identity gives ||DG(T)||<=(1+epsilon_r)||Z_T||(1+||DG(T)||); for ||T||<=2r, ||Z_T||<=(1+d)||T||<=3r. Thus, once epsilon_r+r is below a universal cutoff, absorption yields ||DG(T)||<=K_g*r for a universal K_g.
